concepts.specific: Design A, title "A / DOCK THUMPER". A recognizable long single fat cylindrical shoulder tube with softly squared sleeve, oversized coral front collar, petrol main body, broad off-white top stripe and a tiny cyan status patch. Rear section extends behind shoulder without obscuring head. Small underslung grip, shallow shoulder pad and forward support grip; no large sight blocking top silhouette. Strong lengthwise readable front/back asymmetry. Matching rocket has coral rounded nose, petrol body and three broad pale fins. Read as a heavy launcher immediately from above. Make industrial and cheerful in proportion without writing jokes on it.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original fictional rocket-launcher concept sheet for an irreverent top-down cyberpunk city game. Smooth stylized 3D, rounded bevels, chunky toy-like heavy weapon shapes, restrained surface detail, ordinary industrial design with playful proportions, dark petrol/navy surfaces and vivid coral/cyan accents. No real brands, existing weapon designs, functional engineering, cutaways or internal mechanisms. Dark slate neutral studio background with understated street-asphalt swatch. Clean attractive concept presentation, NOT photorealistic militaria. One consistent design repeated in every view. Layout: large three-quarter hero render on left; large strictly vertically-down top view on upper right with muzzle pointing up; lower right small visual rocket projectile separate from launcher; bottom small unbranded neutral mannequin holding this launcher at shoulder with two hands viewed vertically down, plus simplified dark silhouette. Useful shoulder/grip clearance visible, hands under weapon, face clear. The mannequin is only a pose reference, not a character concept. Thick continuous launcher silhouette and broad visible upper accent panel must survive thumbnail reduction. Target camera is vertically-down north-up perspective at 47 metres, 42 degree FOV, 1280x800; the small posed illustration is conceptual only, not a claimed render at that camera. Launcher visually about 1.3-1.5m long relative to a 1.8m mannequin. Fictional rocket around 0.45m long with bold fins and a blunt rounded nose; no trail or explosion. No dimension callouts, technical blueprints or clutter. Letter label and short concept title only.

concepts.specific: Design B, title "B / ARCADE POD". Distinct broad rectangular single-projectile shoulder pod with generously rounded corners, squat chunky proportions, front black aperture framed by coral squared rim, dark petrol sidewalls and an uninterrupted cyan roof panel. Rear stepped blunt counterweight and dark shallow shoulder rest, small underslung grip and support grip. Clearly a heavy weapon rather than a handheld camera, suitcase or rifle: obvious large front launcher opening, lengthwise directional shape, no carry-handle. Matching rocket with rounded rectangular coral nose shroud and four chunky small fins, stylized capsule. Its top-down footprint should feel broader and heavier than the classic tube concept.
